text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Sheikh Khalifa bin Sulman al-Khalifa says Gulf states should copy Asian economic models to boost prosperity which is a better guarantee of stability than excessive security measures.
- Bahrain to set up vocational standards committee.
- Bahrain's Labour and Social Affairs Minister Abdel-Nabi al-Shula to visit United Arab Emirates later this month for talks to boost labour and social affairs cooperation.
- Bahrian to host 14 commercial exhibitions this year.
- Local gold demand rose by 20 percent last week.
- Arab Shipbuilding and Repair Yard company posts $3.4 million net profit in 1996.
